en.headline: Gloomie Museum exhibition at Harbour City runs until 25 October
en.dek: Local artist Leon Lai’s first solo show featuring his Gloomie cat character is open at Gallery by the Harbour until Sunday, with paintings and sculptures reinterpreting art history and Hong Kong scenes.
body: Hong Kong artist Leon Lai, known as LeonLollipop, is holding his first solo exhibition, Gloomie Museum, at Gallery by the Harbour in Ocean Centre, Harbour City. The show runs until 25 October and presents the artist’s signature cat character through paintings and sculptures.

According to the organiser, the exhibition includes the debut of the 100th Gloomie portrait, inspired by Leonardo da Vinci’s Mona Lisa, alongside seven sculptural figures based on Western art masters and ten cat soldiers modelled on the Terracotta Army. Works also reimagine Hong Kong landmarks through classic art styles, including scenes of Kai Tak and Stanley.

Gallery by the Harbour is open from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. Visitors can collect stamps at four stations to complete a postcard illustration after following the character’s social accounts or purchasing merchandise. The exhibition is located at Shop 207, Level 2, Ocean Centre.

zh.headline: 海港城Gloomie Museum展覽延至25日
zh.dek: 本地藝術家Leon Lai首個個人展覽以Gloomie貓為主題，在海港城Gallery by the Harbour展出至周日，以畫作及雕塑重現藝術史與香港場景。
body: 香港藝術家Leon Lai（LeonLollipop）正於海港城Ocean Centre的Gallery by the Harbour舉行首個個人展覽「Gloomie Museum」。展覽至10月25日，以畫作及雕塑呈現其標誌性貓角色。
主辦方表示，展覽包括第100幅Gloomie肖像首度展出，靈感來自達芬奇的蒙娜麗莎，另有七件受西方藝術大師啟發的雕塑，以及十隻仿兵馬俑的貓士兵。部分作品亦以香港地標重現經典藝術風格，包括啟德及赤柱場景。
Gallery by the Harbour開放時間為上午11時至晚上9時。訪客可在四個印章站收集印章完成明信片插圖，地點為Ocean Centre二樓207號舖。
